title: A limit where the function is undefined
caption: At x = 4 the fraction is 0/0 and so undefined, but away from 4 it equals 1/(√x + 2). The graph has a hole at (4, ¼): values on both sides approach ¼, which is the limit.
alt: The curve y = (√x − 2)/(x − 4) falling gently from left to right with a gap at x = 4, where the height is ¼.
description: The function (√x − 2)/(x − 4) is not defined at x = 4.
As x approaches 4 from either side, the height approaches 1/4: the hole is at (4, ¼).
